summary.project: NAQCC - The New Aquatic & Community Center at Heather Farm Park (AAM 26.06)
notes: HARD = penetration > 0.5"; contact up to 0.5" ignored; CLEARANCE (minor) = duct/equipment within 1" of structure without touching.
Penetration = exact SAT push-out depth of the deepest convex piece pair. Clearance gap = widest separating-axis gap, a lower bound of the true distance (may over-report at skew corners).
Contact point is approximate: centre of the two pieces' AABB intersection, moved to the middle of the overlap along the minimum-penetration axis.
Profiles follow bimlib/mesh.py (channel web and angle leg on -width, double channels back to back); round = inscribed 12-gon, exact at top/bottom/sides; HSS tubes are treated as filled.
Ceiling/soffit test: MEP piece bottom (lowest vertex) vs ceiling underside over the plan overlap; MEP topping out more than 4 ft below a ceiling is treated as another level.

Ceilings applied to the deck/framing (ACT-3 deck panels, GYP-2 1HR) have no plenum: MEP below them is exposed by design and only a real overlap counts. A drop through a rated ceiling = Rated ceiling penetration (major); through a non-rated ceiling = no clash. Clearance (<1") is not reported for MEP whose elevation is assumed.
Intended: riser through roof/deck/roof well = info (opening required); duct or pipe through a non-rated wall = info; curb on roof, equipment on its curb, air terminal in ceiling/wall = none.
Resolutions are rule-based: drops/shifts are the exact moves that clear that element, plus 1"; they do not re-check other elements at the new position.
Grid offsets: + = east of a letter grid / north of a number grid (project north).
